rows.t: │ ═══ Harbinger ═══                                                                                │
│  The Desert Prophet   Iron Age harbinger                                                         │
│  Walks in from the dry country with sand in his beard and one message for the city.              │
│  Warning of impending doom. The Desert Prophet gives no word of when.                            │
│  “He had eaten locusts on the road.”                                                             │
│  “The hunters stayed in.”                                                                        │
│  Severity: high: the harbinger is in open terror                                                 │
│  The omens give no figure. Their words are all you have to go on.                                │
│  Faith strength: 10% (devotion 0.4x, 100% of your faith kept). Stronger faith lowers the odds.   │
│ ── Answers ──                                                                                    │
│   A  Appease: Fast and wear sackcloth   Level 0 / 2                                              │
│      Each level multiplies the real chance it strikes by 0.6.                                    │
│      Next level costs: 1.8K faith                                                                │
│   B  Brace: Raise the walls a course higher   Level 0 / 2                                        │
│      If it comes and you Endure: 19% of buildings fall, 20% of stock is kept.                    │
│      Next level: 14% fall, 34% kept.                                                             │
│      Your garrison is counted: it blunts about 6% of what Brace leaves.                          │
│ A appease · B brace · I invite · ↑↓ scroll · Esc close                                           │
